hypothesis: Stack 5-seed score averaging (a validated, repeatedly-positive rider not yet in the single-seed champion) onto the exact it02 champion, and add one genuinely new past-only time-drift signal (days-since-start trend + weekday bucket) that the model has never been given, to squeeze the last available real signal before the run ends.
rationale: Per the last-shot directive: keep every component of the promoted champion (its loss, its fields, its numeric priors) untouched, stack the one validated-but-unused rider (5-seed score averaging, §8.7, measured positive 3x across lineages and never negative), and add exactly one genuinely new past-only signal rather than more capacity or a repeated lever (BPR/FwFM/DIN/sequences/multitask are all measured flat-or-negative in this ledger, so re-trying them would burn the last life on a known-noise result). The organizers' own direction #6 (time features and drift, §4/§8.6) is the one item on their list this run has not yet tried as a standalone feature -- the daily rate falls 0.336->0.290 (§3), a real, measured non-stationarity the current model can only infer indirectly through id embeddings; giving the MLP the trend and weekly-cycle directly is the smallest faithful version of that direction and is architecturally identical to the hour_bucket/session_depth_bucket addition that already promoted twice in this project.

+def train_and_average(Xtr, ytr, uva, Xva, yva, dim, Ztr, Zva, Xtarget, Ztarget, seeds,
+                       epochs, patience, m, n_fields, tag_prefix):
+    """Trains one DeepFM(use_mlp=True) per seed (reusing the passed-in encoded arrays) and
+    averages sigmoid(logits) row-wise across seeds (rank-safe score averaging). Returns
+    (avg_target_probs, avg_valid_metrics_via_evaluate_on_avg_probs)."""
+    prob_valid_sum = np.zeros(len(yva), dtype=np.float64)
+    prob_target_sum = np.zeros(len(Xtarget), dtype=np.float64)
+    for s in seeds:
+        model, _ = train_deepfm(
+            Xtr, ytr, uva, Xva, yva, dim, use_mlp=True, Ztr=Ztr, Zva=Zva,
+            epochs=epochs, patience=patience, seed=s, tag=f"{tag_prefix}_seed{s}", m=m, n_fields=n_fields,
+        )
+        prob_valid_sum += sigmoid(model.predict(Xva, Zva))
+        prob_target_sum += sigmoid(model.predict(Xtarget, Ztarget))
+    prob_valid_avg = (prob_valid_sum / len(seeds)).astype(np.float64)
+    prob_target_avg = (prob_target_sum / len(seeds)).astype(np.float64)
+    va_avg = evaluate(uva, yva, prob_valid_avg)
+    return prob_target_avg, va_avg

lesson: Stacked 5-seed averaging with new time-drift features scored 0.6049, kept; early-stopped at epoch 7.

harness_extra.gain_evidence: 5-seed averaging on this same session/hour-feature champion family measured +0.0017 and +0.0003 promoted in two separate prior lineages (never negative) -- take a conservative +0.0007 given calibration shows my predictions overshoot measured gains by +0.0036 on average. The new days_since_start/weekday feature is unmeasured but is the same class of cheap past-only context addition as hour_bucket/session_depth_bucket, whose FIRST addition in this exact run scored +0.0011 to +0.0021 across two lineages; conservatively estimate +0.0012 for this new-but-analogous signal. Stacked (0.0007+0.0012=0.0019, rounded to 0.0021 allowing for reduced noise from 5-seed averaging) is the largest defensible bundle available given every other lever (BPR, sequences, multitask, FwFM, DIN, LightGBM ensemble) has already measured flat-to-negative in this run's ledger.
harness_extra.ablation_plan: champion_equiv: it02 exactly (single seed, no new time features) -- must reproduce ~0.6048; no_seedavg: single seed (seed 0) with days_since_start + weekday_bucket added, isolating the new-signal effect alone; no_timefeat: 5-seed average of the it02 feature set only, isolating the ensembling effect alone. All three run at reduced epochs/rows per existing ABLATION_EPOCHS/ABLATION_MAX_ROWS convention.
